label: Shipments LATE
rule: Count shipments with E2 risk LATE, including pending requests.
selection_rule: Evaluation only: choose an available ON_TRACK Wait or Reroute whose full service range meets the original appointment, with the fewest added miles versus the assigned normal route; ties use Wait before Reroute. If neither is ON_TRACK, request a later slot and retain the current Wait metrics until confirmation. Unaffected shipments keep their assigned route. This rule does not select or rank UI responses.
